behaviours.name: Recall to handler on cue
behaviours.observableCriteria: Dog orientates to handler and travels to within arm's reach (or defined app distance) after a single recall cue in the current environment.

behaviours.name: Orient to handler on name
behaviours.observableCriteria: Dog turns head or body to look at handler within 2 seconds of name spoken once at conversational volume.
behaviours.note: App may define latency thresholds provisionally; not universal from sources.

behaviours.name: Sit on verbal cue
behaviours.observableCriteria: Dog places hindquarters on ground and holds sit until release cue or next instruction.

behaviours.name: Conditioned emotional response to marker
behaviours.observableCriteria: Dog shows anticipatory orientation (e.g. looks at handler or treats) immediately after marker with no behaviour requirement yet.
